question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

To pop the question
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To pop the question"** means to propose marriage to someone. (शादी का प्रस्ताव देना)

 
 
• **Example: **John decided** to pop the question** during their vacation in Paris.
 
 
 
• **"To propose marriage"** refers to the act of asking someone to marry you. (शादी का प्रस्ताव देना)
 
 
• **Example: **He planned a romantic dinner** to propose marriage **to his girlfriend.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To ask a nonsense question** (बेवकूफी भरा सवाल पूछना): Asking a question that is silly or lacks sense.

 
 
• **Example:** He often disrupts the class by asking nonsense questions.
 
 
 
• **To mark important details** (महत्वपूर्ण विवरणों को चिन्हित करना): Highlighting or noting down key information.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher asked us to mark important details in our textbooks.
 
 
 
• **To give a wrong answer** (गलत उत्तर देना): Responding incorrectly to a question.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his confidence, he gave a wrong answer during the quiz.
